intent: Selection must be a real, persistent, non-color cue and keyboard operable; decoration removed. Over-correction risk: deleting the 'Most popular' badge or all card boundaries.

must_match.note: selected plan exposed as state, not just a class

must_not_match.note: looping animation must be removed or gated by reduced motion

manual: Selected plan identifiable without color and after focus moves away
'Most popular' badge still present and still visually distinct
Cards still read as separate selectable options (some boundary retained)
Hover-only 'What's included?' text reachable by keyboard or always visible
